520701.name: Gatling Gun
520701.description: Fires Gatling guns at the Nikke with the highest ATK, dealing damage.

520702.name: Multi-Barrel Missile Pod
520702.description:
Fires missiles from multi-barrel missile pods, dealing damage to a single Nikke. 
Missiles can be intercepted.

520703.name: Machine Gun
520703.description:
Fires machine guns mounted on both sides, dealing damage to the Nikke with the highest ATK.
The machine guns can be destroyed.

520705.name: Missile Container
520705.description: Fires missiles from the missile containers on both sides, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

520707.name: Giant Pincer Attack
520707.description:
Throws huge rocks with her pincers, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
The attack begins from right to left.
The huge rocks can be destroyed.

520709.name: Shockwave Device
520709.description: Generates a code barrier and smashes the ground to create a powerful shock wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.

520710.name: Charged Attack
520710.description: Charges forward, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

520711.name: Giant Pincer Attack
520711.description:
Throws huge rocks with her pincers, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
The attack begins from right to left.
The huge rocks can be destroyed.

520715.name: Overdriven Missile Container
520715.description:
Fires overdriven missiles from missile containers at both sides after Hyper Charger is fully charged, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Missiles can be intercepted.

520717.name: Overdriven Shockwave Device
520717.description: Behemoth leaps into the air and slams the ground to create a powerful shock wave once Hyper Charger is fully charged. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

520718.name: Overdriven Charged Attack
520718.description:
Rushes forward after Hyper Charger is fully charged, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
During her warm-up, deals damage to all Nikkes from her overdriven energy.
Damage from the overdriven energy can be halted through Special Interruption.
